name: Married couple, two children, paid their 17-year-old son for after-school care of his sister
source: Form 6744 (Rev. 10-2026) Advanced Scenario 2, interview notes (structure only; tax year 2025 rules apply).
official_outcome: Care paid to the couple's own child under 19 does not qualify for the child and dependent care credit.
background: married, two kids, paid our son to watch his sister after school
